desc: Read N and the binary string A, collecting all '0'/'1' characters until the length equals 3^N.
Initialize `dp0` and `dp1` lists: for each bit b in A, append (0,1) if b=='0', else (1,0).
While len(dp0) > 1, combine each triple using the transition formulas.
Compute current root value `cur` by iteratively taking majority of groups of 3 on A.
Print dp1[0] if cur == 0, else dp0[0].
Test the provided solution with the two sample inputs and confirm outputs are 1 and 2 respectively.
Run additional brute force tests for N=2 with random strings to ensure DP matches the brute-force enumeration of all possible flip subsets, covering edge cases like all-zeros and all-ones.
Test maximum N=13 to ensure performance is acceptable.
If any test fails, debug the DP transition or parsing; otherwise, mark the solution as complete.
